name: Moss Paths
description: A quiet garden of stream tiles. Turn each tile until water from the spring reaches every bed. A garden each day that remembers your best, or a new one whenever you like.
author: Lullshift

help.summary: A garden (4 by 4, 6 by 6 or 8 by 8) where every tile holds a piece of stream: an end, a straight, a bend, a tee or a crossing. Turning tiles joins the streams into one network.
help.goal: Water every bed. Tiles joined to the spring turn blue, and you win when every tile is blue. There is no timer, and fewer moves is only a bonus.
howToPlay: Find the spring, the tile with the ring in the middle.
Turn a tile a quarter turn so its stream lines up with its neighbours. Water only passes where two tiles open toward each other.
Watch the Watered count grow until every tile is blue.

Today's garden is the same for everyone today and remembers your best. New garden deals a fresh one. Restart tangles the same garden again, and Undo takes back your last turn. Size switches between 4 by 4, 6 by 6 and 8 by 8 and deals that size's garden.

controls.action: Reach Undo, Restart, the garden buttons and Size

tips: Start from the spring and work outward, one tile at a time.
Ends and bends in the corners and along the edges can only point inward, so fix those first.
A crossing looks the same from every side, so turning it changes nothing. You can turn it and Undo takes it back, but it doesn't count as a move.
You can stop at any time. Your garden is saved and waits for you.
